comparison_note: Transductive link prediction: learns from biology + 80% of known treatments, predicts the held-out 20%. Complementary to the mechanism-only benchmark (AUROC 0.73), which uses NO treatment data.

findings.title: KG-embedding predicts held-out treatment edges
findings.detail: A DistMult embedding of the Hetionet graph predicts the held-out 20% of Compound-treats-Disease edges with AUROC 0.694 (Hits@10 0.44, MRR 0.21) — capturing indirect multi-hop biology the direct target-overlap score cannot. Held-out edges are absent from training.
findings.capa: Re-train on each graph refresh; track AUROC/Hits@10. Integrate the embedding score as an additional engine signal (needs ChEMBL→DrugBank node mapping).
